mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (potassium, magnesium) while valsartan increases potassium retention and reduces renal perfusion, creating compounded renal dysfunction and unpredictable hyperkalemia risk.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, electrolytes (especially potassium), and blood pressure closely; consider temporary discontinuation of valsartan during amphotericin B therapy or use liposomal formulation to minimize nephrotoxicity.
